messages.subject: Plot position
parts:
Hello, 

Is it possible that, if you have 3 plots, one above the other, and hid the second one with the checkbox , the others goes up?  At this moment, each plot has its own space, automatically. 

Thanks.

Greetings,

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Plot position
parts:
Try adding height="auto" to your plotOutput, and height=400 to your renderPlot.

e.g.
plotOutput("plot1", height="auto")

renderPlot({
  ...
}, height=400)
